content.title: Vanessa Trump standing by boyfriend Tiger Woods after DUI arrest: report
content.text: Vanessa Trump is reportedly standing by boyfriend Tiger Woods following his DUI arrest, and has no plans to break up with him. Trump — who’s been dating Woods for over a year now — has discussed her boyfriend’s car crash and arrest with him but the two aren’t arguing about it, TMZ reported. Instead, she’s “fully supportive” of him as he looks ahead to what’s next when it comes to getting back on the right path, according to the outlet. There’s been “absolutely no talks of breaking up,” the outlet also reported. Vanessa Trump is reportedly “fully supportive” of Tiger Woods following his DUI arrest last Friday. They’re seen here together in March 2025. X/@TigerWoods Trump has absolutely no plans of breaking up with her boyfriend of over a year after his fourth car crash, according to TMZ. She’s pictured here giving Woods a hug earlier this month. GREG LOVETT/PALM BEACH POST / USA TODAY NETWORK via Imagn Images Page Six reached out to Woods’ rep but didn’t immediately receive a response. The Daily Mail reported Monday, however, that Trump went from concerned to “angry” at Woods’ alleged cavalier response to his fourth car crash — and it could mean the end of their relationship. “She was like, ‘let’s solve this together,’ and his response was basically, ‘yeah yeah yeah, I got it. It’s fine. It’s under control,'” an insider claimed to the outlet. “And she’s like, ‘It is so obviously not under control.'” The former model is looking ahead to the future and helping Woods get back on the right path, the outlet also reported. The couple is seen here in March 2025. X/@TigerWoods But the Daily Mail reported Monday that Trump will “100 percent walk” from the relationship if Woods isn’t able to fix his issues. Getty Images Want more celebrity and pop culture news? Start your day with Page Six Daily. Thanks for signing up! The source insisted that the mother of five is “not going to put up with this.” “She needs stability and this is not stable,” the source said. “If he can’t fix this, she will 100 percent walk. She’s trying to make that clear without it sounding like an ultimatum, but obviously it kind of is.” A source previously described Trump and Woods’ relationship to People as “intense.” “Vanessa and Tiger are in love,” the insider said, though they added that Woods can be “difficult to be around” at times because of the pain he experiences following his multiple surgeries and injuries. Woods was arrested on March 27 following his shocking rollover crash in Jupiter Island, Florida. via REUTERS Woods — pictured here leaving the Martin County Sheriff’s Office following his arrest on March 27 — pleaded not guilty in his DUI case Tuesday. Christopher Oquendo for NY Post “It’s serious but Tiger has yet to look in the mirror and say, ‘You’re 50 years old and need to act like it.’” Woods broke his silence Tuesday after his arrest, sharing that he’s stepping away for a period of time to seek treatment and focus on his health. The golf great has pleaded not guilty in his DUI case. He waived his arraignment and demanded a jury trial, per the court documents obtained by Page Six Tuesday.
